_comment: Curated overlay merged onto OSM data by normalized name match. price: 1=$ cheap … 4=$$$$. health: strong|ok|trap (fit for Danny's protein+veg goals). verified: facts confirmed in person or from primary sources, with date.

reveille coffee co.notes: Default morning office; closes 4pm. Healthy picks: Tahini Squash Bowl (lunch, 11:15+), Breakfast Bowl (all day). Skip: burrito (tater tots), acai/granola (sugar). Add-on math: +1 egg $2.50 ok, avocado add-on redundant.

cavalli cafe.notes: Danny's find: two floors, 2nd floor good for relaxed work; open late (Mon 10pm, Tue-Sun ~11pm) — solves the everything-closes-at-4 problem. Decaf lattes. Food is comfort Italian (panini, cannoli); tuna sandwich = most protein-forward.

comptons coffe house.notes: Backup office: free fast wifi, outlet bar under counter, ~6 solo tables; tight at peak, go early. Apple Pay unverified.

caffe trieste.notes: CASH-LEANING. Oldest espresso bar on the West Coast (1956). Weekend cappuccino spot, culturally analog — not an office. Open late (~10pm).

caffe greco.notes: CASH ONLY (verified in person). Open until ~11pm — the evening decaf-latte spot once you carry cash. Joe-app mobile ordering listing is stale.

molinari delicatessen.notes: 100-year-old deli next door to 371 Columbus. Danny's healthy order (verified 8/31): Custom Sandwich $19.25 — oven roasted turkey, soft roll, lettuce, tomatoes, mustard, NO cheese; add sweet bell peppers +$1 for bulk. Online pickup orders 9am-5:10pm. Cured-meat specials are the trap while cutting. Closed Sundays.

trader joes.notes: Staples HQ, open to 9pm; has a parking lot. The zero-cook kit: Just Grilled Chicken Strips + salad kit + avocado (~$8 dinner); steamed lentils; tofu spring rolls (fresh, not fried — appetizer not meal); pre-peeled boiled eggs; Greek yogurt; frozen backup meals as the delivery-app circuit breaker.

lukes local grocery.notes: 2 min from home, 8am-9pm. Quality tier but pricey (deli plates ~$16, $11 tiny burrito — Danny verified) — role: emergency ingredients + prepared dinner when the TJ's window is missed, NOT staples or everyday lunch. Real butcher counter.

wok shop.notes: Buy the 6-qt stockpot here (sous vide bath + soup pot). Cheap restaurant-grade kitchenware.

golden boy pizza.notes: Legendary focaccia squares. A treat, not a system — log it for intentional nights.

vital tea leaf.notes: Free try-before-you-buy tasting bar, ~300 teas (ask for Uncle Gee). Buy loose-leaf green (~$0.30/cup at home) — the budget green-tea habit.

gourmet delight bbq.notes: Siu mei (roast meat) counter on Stockton, on the walk to Betty Ann Ong rec center. Roast pork/duck/soy chicken over rice + choy sum = 40g+ protein, ~$10-13. Pre-gym meal. Likely cash.

kam po kitchen.notes: Best-known roast-meat shop in the neighborhood (Broadway at Powell). Same order: roast pork or duck over rice, extra vegetables; skip crispy pork belly before lifting.

hons wun tun house.notes: Wonton noodle soup, one block from Betty Ann Ong. Lighter pre-gym option (~25g protein). Cash.

extras.name: Grocery Outlet
extras.notes: Opened Aug 2026 in the old Safeway space, across from Trader Joe's. Deep-discount pantry staples; stock rotates. Not yet in OSM.

extras.name: Fiddle Fig Cafe
extras.notes: Roomy, plant-filled, laptop-normal. Wifi password 'coffeeandplants', outlets, sunny corner + sidewalk seats. Good breakfast burrito. Not yet in OSM.

extras.name: Stockton St produce stalls
extras.notes: Cheapest produce in SF; several stalls, treat as one corridor. Mostly cash — bring small bills. Google Translate camera mode for labels.
